abstract: Tubal choriocarcinoma is uncommon, and its magnetic resonance imaging characteristics have not yet been reported. In this report, a 39-year-old woman presented with irregular painless vaginal bleeding and a palpable left lower abdominal lump for 2 months following 6 weeks' amenorrhea and positive urine pregnancy test. Her serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin value was significantly increased. Ultrasound revealed a left adnexal mass, which showed no blood flow signal on Color doppler flow imaging. A further MR examination showed a well-defined cystic-solid mass with cystic component accounting for a large proportion in the left lower abdomen. The solid part with mixed signals resembled a honeycomb. Finally, the left tubal choriocarcinoma was confirmed by pathology. When the solid parts of cystic-solid mass appeared as "honeycomb appearance" and the ovaries were normal by magnetic resonance imaging, together with typical symptoms and significantly elevated β-human chorionic gonadotropin values, radiologists should feel more confident in suspecting tubal choriocarcinoma and reporting it on their differential.
abstract_ja: 卵管絨毛癌はまれであり、その磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の所見はこれまで報告されていない。本報告では、39歳女性が、無月経6週間と尿妊娠反応陽性の後、2か月にわたる不規則な無痛性の腟出血と左下腹部の触知可能な腫瘤を主訴として来院した。血清β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン値は著明に上昇していた。超音波検査で左付属器腫瘤を認め、カラードプラ血流画像では血流信号を認めなかった。さらにMR検査で、左下腹部に大部分が嚢胞成分からなる境界明瞭な嚢胞充実性腫瘤を認めた。混合信号を示す充実部は蜂巣状に見えた。最終的に病理学的検査で左卵管絨毛癌と確定した。嚢胞充実性腫瘤の充実部が「蜂巣様外観」を示し、MRIで卵巣が正常である場合、典型的な症状や著明に上昇したβ-hCG値と合わせると、放射線科医は卵管絨毛癌を強く疑い、鑑別診断に挙げることにより自信をもつべきである。
